title: Contact Oops Mine Co.: Email, Phone and Boutique Hours
seo_title: Contact Oops Mine Co. | Email, Phone & Hours
meta_description: Contact Oops Mine Co.: email hello@oopsmineco.com, call 346-847-6606 or send a note. Boutique hours, what to write in about, and answers before you ask.

hero.intro: There is one person behind this boutique, and she reads every note. Ask about a size, an order, a piece you saw on a Facebook Live and cannot find again — or tell us what you wish we carried. That last one shapes what we buy next.

sections.heading: What to write in about
paragraphs: Nothing is too small to send. A question about a waist measurement is the same to us as a question about a package that has gone quiet: one person, one inbox, one answer. Write to hello@oopsmineco.com, use the form on this page, or call 346-847-6606 during boutique hours. Give us your order number if you have one and the name of the piece you mean — that saves us both a round of emails.
Many of the everyday answers are already written down: the FAQ covers ordering, sizing and where we are, and the shipping policy covers how orders leave us. If yours is not in there, ask us directly.
bullets: Orders. A package that has gone quiet, a tracking link that will not open, something you need changed — start at order tracking, then write if it still looks wrong.
Sizing and fit. Send your measurements and the piece you are eyeing. The size guide covers the general rules; we can talk you through one dress.
Returns. Email us for an RMA number before you mail anything back. The steps, the timing and the exceptions are on the refund and returns policy page.
Collaborations and wholesale. Stylists, small shops, anyone who wants to work with us: send the details and Ronalyn reads it herself.
Press. Writing about the boutique? Ask us for images, or point your readers at our story.
Just because. A piece you are hunting for, a color you wish we carried, or a photo of you in the one you claimed on sight — an oops, mine moment we get to see.

sections.heading: When you will hear back
paragraphs: We reply on business days, usually within a day. Notes that land on a Saturday evening or on Sunday wait for the next morning we are open, and a question that needs a tape measure or a look at a package can take a little longer — we would rather send you the right answer than a fast one. If a few days pass with nothing from us, look in your spam folder, then write again. Sometimes the reply is the thing that goes missing.
The phone rings at the same hours as the inbox, Central Time. Miss us and you can leave your name and a number; we call back on the next business day.

sections.heading: Email, phone and where the mail goes
paragraphs: Email is the fastest way in: hello@oopsmineco.com. The phone is 346-847-6606, open Monday to Friday 8:30am to 5:00pm and Saturday 10:00am to 5:00pm, Central Time, closed on Sunday. Both reach the same person, so pick whichever suits the question — typing out three measurements is easier than reading them aloud, and a package problem is often quicker said than written.

We are an online boutique in Houston, Texas. There is no rack to walk past and no fitting room to book, so the address below is for mail only. Returns go there once you have an RMA number, never before it — a box with no number on it arrives with nothing to match it to.

Oops Mine Co. LLC
12712 W Lake Houston Pkwy, Ste B-4014
Houston, TX 77044
Mailing address only — no walk-ins.

Facebook is the other door. It is where we go live, show new pieces on the hanger and answer whatever gets typed into the comments; the link sits in the details card above and in the footer of every page. More places to find us will appear here as they open — we would rather leave a gap than point you at an account that is not ours.

sections.heading: Working together
paragraphs: Small shops, stylists, photographers and writers: we like these notes. Send what you have in mind, the pieces or sizes you are thinking of, and any dates that matter. Wholesale questions get a straight answer — we buy in small runs from suppliers in Korea and Thailand and sell them one at a time, so tell us what you need and we will say plainly what we can and cannot do. Press requests can have images and the story behind the name; just ask.

faqs.a: Start at order tracking. Put in the order number from your confirmation email and the email address you used at checkout, and it will show you where the package stands. If the page comes back empty, or the tracking has not moved in a while, write to us with that order number and we will chase it from our side.

faqs.q: How do I start a return?
faqs.a: Email hello@oopsmineco.com and ask for an RMA number before you mail anything. Returns are postmarked within seven days of the purchase date, come back in new and unused condition with the original tags on, and are refunded as store credit. Some pieces cannot be returned at all. The full terms and the return address are on the refund and returns policy page — read it before you pack.

Go by the measurements, not the letter: our pieces come from Korea and Thailand, where sizes run smaller than US ones. Every listing carries flat measurements, and the size guide shows how to measure yourself and what petite means here. Stuck between two sizes? Send us your bust, waist and hip with the piece you are looking at and we will tell you which one we would pull.

faqs.q: Can I come and see the clothes?
faqs.a: We are online only. The Houston address on this page is a mailbox rather than a shop floor, so there are no walk-ins and no fitting room. The listings are built to make up for it — flat measurements, close-ups of the fabric, and a Facebook Live where pieces get shown on the hanger and on a body. Ask us anything you would have asked across a counter.

faqs.q: What should I put in my message?
faqs.a: Your order number if there is one, the email address you used at checkout, and the name or color of the piece you mean. For anything that arrived wrong, add two photos: the item and the label. The more of that in the first note, the fewer times we have to write back asking, and the sooner you get an answer you can act on.

cta.heading: Find something yours
cta.text: While you are here: new pieces land in small batches, and the list hears about them first. Leave your email and we will tell you when something arrives that is worth a second look.

author_notes: No keywords are assigned to this page in plan.json, so primary_keyword and keywords are empty on purpose — the copy is written for people, not a search phrase. Every fact comes from the brief or the client return policy: hello@oopsmineco.com, 346-847-6606, Mon-Fri 8:30am-5:00pm, Sat 10:00am-5:00pm, Sun closed (Central Time), 12712 W Lake Houston Pkwy, Ste B-4014, Houston, TX 77044 as a mailing address with no walk-ins, RMA by email, seven-day postmark, store credit. No response-time promise is made anywhere: the wording is "we reply on business days, usually within a day". Facebook is referred to without a URL because the link comes from the Customizer social settings that omc_contact_details() reads; no Instagram or TikTok is named until the owner supplies handles. The hours table repeats what the details card shows on purpose (the card is short, the table is what a shopper scrolls back to). Links used: /faq/, /shipping-policy/, /order-tracking/, /size-guide/, /refund_returns/, /about-us/, /shop/?orderby=date, mailto: and tel:. Integrator: the page slug 'contacts' already exists from the demo import, so this upserts rather than creating a second page, and the template is templates/page-contact.php, which prints omc_contact_card() and the contact form above these sections. If Contact Form 7 is not active the theme's own form (action omc_contact) is used — worth one test send on oopsmine.test.
